Components

Vodka

Vodka provisions a Windows environment (a Wine prefix) on the Mac, installs Steam into it, and presents the resulting games in a library. It is a fork of Whisky, via frankea's community fork, focused on Steam gaming: per-game settings, launcher fixes, controller support and Retina-correct rendering.

The application comprises four targets and one Swift package:

Part Responsibility
apps/vodka/Vodka/ SwiftUI application: bottles, library, settings, onboarding.
apps/vodka/VodkaKit/ Logic: Wine, Steam, game database, playtime, downloads, diagnostics.
apps/vodka/VodkaCmd/ Command-line helper used by Dock shortcuts to launch games.
apps/vodka/VodkaThumbnail/ Quick Look thumbnails for .exe files.
apps/vodka/VodkaUITests/ UI tests for the application shell and bottle flow.

Where changes belong:

Change Location
Window and application UI apps/vodka/Vodka/
Wine, bottle or Steam behaviour apps/vodka/VodkaKit/Sources/VodkaKit/
A game's settings or launch flags apps/vodka/VodkaKit/Sources/VodkaKit/GameDatabase/Resources/GameDB.json
User-facing text apps/vodka/Vodka/Localizable.xcstrings (English only; regenerate en-GB)
The Wine runtime the app downloads apps/vodka/VodkaKit/Sources/VodkaKit/Utils/DistributionConfig.swift
Build, release, signing apps/vodka/scripts/ and apps/vodka/docs/ReleaseWorkflow.md
Contribution rules apps/vodka/CONTRIBUTING.md

The Windows runtime (Libraries.tar.gz) is not bundled. The application downloads it during setup, and the exact component versions and hashes are recorded in apps/vodka/docs/DEPENDENCIES.md.

OpenV

OpenV replaces ScriptHookV for GTA V Enhanced when a game patch breaks it. Signatures and native tables are data files, so supporting a new game build does not require recompilation. Existing .asi plugins (Menyoo, NativeTrainer and others) load unmodified against the provided ScriptHookV.dll.

OpenV is single-player only: it refuses GTA Online and BattlEye, contains no anti-cheat bypass and ships no game assets. apps/openv/PLAN.md documents the ABI contract and the design.

Path Contents
apps/openv/src/ C implementation and export definitions.
apps/openv/data/ Shipped per-build data: native map and game-internals map (1158.16).
apps/openv/tools/dump/ Helpers that dump the running game and its native table.
apps/openv/tools/probe/ In-game probe DLL and injector.
apps/openv/research/ Reverse-engineering scripts, crossmaps and solver experiments.
apps/openv/docs/re/ Derivation of the native table and crossmap.
apps/openv/Rebuild OpenV Map.command One-click rebuild after a GTA V update (approximately 20 minutes).
apps/openv/HOW TO FIX MODS AFTER A GTA UPDATE.txt User-facing guide.

winecx

A patched Wine/CrossOver source tree, imported from rolling7ho/winecx (branch d3dmetal-errno), which itself mirrors the public CrossOver source. Vodka's runtimes are built from this tree and the other engine lanes. The tree carries the Mac driver, Retina and D3DMetal fixes that the application ships. Source is tracked here with its full history; the original repository is archived and redirects here.

engine/winecx/ is a committed subtree: edit it and commit at the workspace root. The runtime lanes under engine/runtime-* are separate local checkouts and are untracked.

dxmt

A Metal-based implementation of Direct3D 11 and 10 for macOS and Wine, imported from rolling7ho/dxmt (branch teardown). Vodka builds its Direct3D 12 bridge from this tree as vodkametal, so the bridge sits beside the runtime's own winemetal instead of replacing it. The two submodules (external/nvapi, include/native/directx) are vendored, so the monorepo is self-contained.

Build it with apps/vodka/scripts/build-vodka-d3d12.sh. Output is written to apps/vodka/build/vodka-d3d12/ and embedded by apps/vodka/scripts/install-local.sh. The DXMT toolchain (engine/dxmt-work/dxmt/toolchains/) remains local and untracked.

Xcode build products are written to .build/ at the repository root. swift test writes to apps/vodka/VodkaKit/.build, which is ignored separately. The untracked lanes under engine/ and the apps/openv/.venv environment are local caches that can be regenerated.

Getting started

An Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 15 or later with Xcode 16 or later is required.

apps/vodka/scripts/install-local.sh

# Unit tests
swift test --package-path apps/vodka/VodkaKit

# Formatting (CI pins SwiftFormat 0.58.7) and lint
cd apps/vodka && swiftformat --lint . && swiftlint --strict

OpenV's rebuild command expects GTA V Enhanced to be installed in a Vodka bottle. The command launches the game, dumps the required data and writes a new map. The engine lanes have their own build recipe in engine/local-build.rb.

Git and releases

  • origin is https://github.com/rolling7ho/vodka-stack.git, branch main, which is this monorepo.
  • Vodka, OpenV, winecx and dxmt were imported with git subtree, so their full commit graphs are present. git log --follow <file> reads pre-move history.
  • rolling7ho/winecx and rolling7ho/dxmt are archived read-only and redirect here; their branches are retained for history.
  • Every change lands through a pull request. Direct pushes to main are not accepted.
  • The Sparkle update feed is served from the gh-pages branch at https://rolling7ho.github.io/vodka-stack/appcast.xml. Releases are produced with apps/vodka/scripts/publish-update.sh, which also updates the appcast.
  • CI workflows remain under apps/vodka/.github, inherited from the application repository, so GitHub does not run them from the monorepo root. Run the checks locally.

Contributing

Contributions are welcome: bug reports, game compatibility notes, fixes, documentation and translations. Read CONTRIBUTING.md first; it identifies which project guide applies, the checks to run and the commit style. Use the issue forms for bugs and feature requests, and SECURITY.md for security reports.

Participation is covered by the Code of Conduct. By contributing you agree to license your work under the terms of the area you change (see NOTICE.md). There is no CLA.
